added_models.model: Gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into immunodeficient mouse skin / regenerated RDEB skin (D-Fi)

engagement.model: Gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into immunodeficient mouse skin / regenerated RDEB skin (D-Fi)
engagement.population: COL7A1-mutant RDEB (pz-cel/PTR-01: NC1-expressing, no anti-C7 immunity)
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC). FCX-007 uses a SIN lentiviral CMV-COL7A1 vector; the 2003 cells were not that product, so product_in_model false.
engagement.judgement: The academic system behind intradermal gene-corrected fibroblast therapy; Fibrocell's own FCX-007 mouse data were never published in a citable source.
engagement.note: Intradermally injected gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts gave stable human C7 at the mouse dermal-epidermal junction.
engagement.short: Injected fibroblasts put C7 at DEJ
engagement.quote: Further, intradermal injection of normal human or gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts into mouse skin resulted in the stable expression of human type VII collagen at the mouse DEJ.

engagement.model: Gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into immunodeficient mouse skin / regenerated RDEB skin (D-Fi)
engagement.magnitude_basis: linear C7 at the DEJ by immunofluorescence after intradermal injection, mouse vs patient skin
engagement.population: COL7A1-mutant RDEB (pz-cel/PTR-01: NC1-expressing, no anti-C7 immunity)
engagement.confidence_note: Sponsor-hosted conference poster (PDF created 2020-01-16), read in full. The registry results (NCT02810951, posted 2021-09-16) report only AEs and wound closure, not C7. The 2018 JID abstract 591 (10.1016/j.jid.2018.03.599) is paywalled and may date this earlier.
engagement.judgement: Judgement call: C7 at the DEJ is shown for 2 of 6 subjects only, so same with source_calls_it partial; paired by me with the 2003 mouse paper. Proximal: C7 is the transgene's product.
engagement.note: In the FCX-007 phase 1/2, linear C7 appeared at the DEJ of injected skin up to 52 weeks in the subjects shown, as in mice.
engagement.short: C7 at patients' DEJ, two subjects shown
engagement.quote: Linear C7 protein was detected by IF at the dermal-epidermal junction at 25 weeks and 52 weeks following injection into skin of subject 0101, and at 12 and 25 weeks in subject 0103.
engagement.reason: C7 deposited in patients, poster only

efficacy.model: Gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into immunodeficient mouse skin / regenerated RDEB skin (D-Fi)
efficacy.population: COL7A1-mutant RDEB (pz-cel/PTR-01: NC1-expressing, no anti-C7 immunity)
efficacy.judgement: The mice showed molecular restoration, read as a class-level prediction that injected fibroblasts would correct RDEB skin.
efficacy.note: Restoring C7 by intradermal gene-corrected fibroblasts implied RDEB skin could be corrected by direct injection.
efficacy.quote: These data demonstrate that human dermal fibroblasts alone are capable of producing type VII collagen at the DEJ, and it is possible to restore type VII collagen gene expression in RDEB skin in vivo by direct intradermal injection of fibroblasts.

efficacy.model: Gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into immunodeficient mouse skin / regenerated RDEB skin (D-Fi)
efficacy.magnitude_basis: complete closure of the first wound pair at week 24, treated vs control (1/6 vs 0/6)
efficacy.population: COL7A1-mutant RDEB (pz-cel/PTR-01: NC1-expressing, no anti-C7 immunity)
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry results read via ClinicalTrials.gov API; no peer-reviewed DEFI-RDEB paper found. Enrollment 6 of a planned larger phase 3.
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: 1 of 6 vs 0 of 6 closures with 6 patients enrolled is inconclusive, not a demonstrated failure, so untested/unsettled rather than contra (the checker raised this as a rule question). Phase 1/2 wound closure was a secondary, so it changes no status.
efficacy.note: DEFI-RDEB enrolled 6 patients: the first treated wound pair closed fully at week 24 in 1 versus 0 controls; inconclusive.
efficacy.quote: Complete wound closure of the first wound pair (treated vs. control)

patient_trials.quote: Percentage of target wounds achieving complete wound closure (greater than 90%) at all post-baseline visits

considered_not_added: Wild-type BALB/c GLP toxicology mice (B-VEC, IV/intradermal/topical): already in the draft's safety cell, mislabelled with the hypomorph/xenograft model_id; the checker's fix is a relabel of those draft entries, not a new track here
